title: QUIC RFC 9000 S8P1P4 Retry Token Source Binding and Lifetime Verification
verification_method: Focused S8P1P4 requirement-home tests over listener Retry bootstrap replay admission, source-port rejection, port-bound token lifetime validation, deterministic port mutation fuzzing, and anti-amplification budget enforcement, followed by Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the focused generated S8P1P4 hard proof tail for Retry token source endpoint continuity, short Retry token lifetime, and anti-amplification behavior when the client address changes.
expected_result: The focused tests show that a Retry replay from the original source endpoint is validated and admitted, the same Retry token from a fresh source port is rejected before admission, port-bound token validation rejects mutated source ports, the token remains accepted through its expiration boundary and is rejected immediately after, and the anti-amplification budget remains capped at three times received bytes for an unvalidated changed address.
procedure: Run the focused S8P1P4 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The listener Retry bootstrap path remains gated behind retryBootstrapEnabled.
The address-validation token protector remains the listener-owned source of Retry and NEW_TOKEN token integrity.
The anti-amplification budget remains the primitive used for unvalidated peer-address send accounting.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim cluster-wide Retry token state, persistent token secrets across listener restarts, public token-management APIs, hosted interop readiness, or closure of unrelated deferred fuzz obligations.

status_summary: Local verification on 2026-05-06 passed: focused S8P1P4 requirement-home filter 7/7; Release build 0 warnings/errors; regenerated QUIC coverage triage 1,326/1,771 trace-clean; SpecTrace core validation 499 artifacts; full Release no-build suite 4,598/4,598; git diff --check exited 0 with only CRLF normalization warnings for generated triage files.
